note: Extension AIX-K2 model questioner: after a person's answer was read (KNO-07), the model proposes the NEXT clarifying question of the interview. The server keeps it only if it is plain text and grounded in the conversation (it names the rule, an uncovered part of the last answer, a contradicted field or the matter of the deterministic question); otherwise the deterministic question is asked and labelled as the fallback. The server always appends the option to say 'I do not know'. Pinned in docs/evaluation/FINAL_AI_QUALITY_PLAN.md.
